name: Garbha Gauri Rudraksha
description: A larger and smaller naturally joined formation associated with Gauri and Ganesha, traditionally kept for nurturing, motherhood, the parent–child bond, family affection, and devotional care.
alt: Representative render of a Garbha Gauri Nepali Rudraksha with larger and smaller naturally joined lobes on deep green stone
note: Illustrative render only. The size difference and join must be natural, never glued; origin, X-ray or lab report, and authenticity must be verified. This devotional association is not a fertility, pregnancy, or medical claim.
